name: Salih ibn Abd al-Quddus
bio: Salih ibn Abd al-Quddus preached in Basra and wrote verse on conduct, much of it circulated as proverbs. Biographers remember his debates with the theologian Abu al-Hudhayl al-Allaf. He was accused of heresy and executed in Baghdad, in accounts that disagree about his prosecution. Al-Zirikli dates his death to about 160 AH (777 CE). Abd Allah al-Khatib collected the scattered verses, recording the different attributions attached to them.
